terms.definition: A visual file where you design screens and link them together by dragging.

terms.definition: A property that connects an object in the storyboard to your code.

terms.definition: A transition from one screen to another that you define in a storyboard.

video.title: Storyboard, Outlet & Segue | Day 98
video.description:
Learn to explain how storyboard screens connect to your Swift code: Storyboard, Outlet & Segue, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Storyboard - A visual file where you design screens and link them together by dragging.
Outlet - A property that connects an object in the storyboard to your code.
Segue - A transition from one screen to another that you define in a storyboard.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 98 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: iOS Storyboard, Outlet & Segue | Day 98
landscape.description:
Explain Storyboard, Outlet & Segue in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
스토리보드, 아울렛, 세그 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Storyboard - A visual file where you design screens and link them together by dragging.
한국어: 스토리보드: 드래그해서 화면을 디자인하고 서로 연결하는 시각적 파일

Outlet - A property that connects an object in the storyboard to your code.
한국어: 아울렛: 스토리보드의 객체를 코드와 연결해 주는 프로퍼티

Segue - A transition from one screen to another that you define in a storyboard.
한국어: 세그: 스토리보드에서 정의한, 한 화면에서 다른 화면으로의 전환

In this video, Mina and Jake fix a crash on the profile screen and a missing arrow, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: The label is nil and the crash is yours. Can you explain it in English?

dialogue.title: The profile screen crashes

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the app crashes when I open the profile screen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's an Outlet problem. Is the Outlet connected in the Storyboard?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, I deleted the label and added a new one.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then the old Outlet is broken. Drag a new connection.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Fixed. But the Segue to the settings screen is gone too.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Check the Storyboard. A Segue is an arrow between two screens.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I see it. The arrow was deleted by mistake.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add the Segue again, and give it an identifier.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. Now `show` fills the label and the screen opens.
Your whole app flow fits in one Storyboard.
